name: m4-uniques-paired

variantDescriptions.chunked: `ChunkedInterner(weak = false)`: types held strongly until the run ends
variantDescriptions.uncache-all: chunked-weak, and new types made in any weak scope (boolean type queries, param-cloning type maps, `adapt`'s polymorphic instantiation, `narrowForFindMember`, existentials, `Mixin.cloneBeforeErasure`, `instantiateTypeParams`, `stableTypeFor`) are not interned; a 4096-slot direct-mapped cache shares repeats

description: Paired rerun of [m4-uniques-uncache](#c-m4-uniques-uncache) (job 546), whose forks varied by ±14% in time, far more than any difference between the variants. Here the four table layouts alternate iteration by iteration within each fork (Williams order, 4 cycles measured), switched by `-Yuniques-layout` and `-Yuniques-uncache`, so JIT differences between forks cancel. Build `claude/uniques-audit` `bd33c027bb` (retronym/scala#212 + #239 + probes; census off). Read `paired.<v>.delta%` and the xctrace per-variant counters.
Caveat: variants share one heap, so the old generation one variant leaves behind is collected during the next's iterations.
